request.style: English, male soulful voice with deep choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, cello, mournful and heavy, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul
Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab
The genealogy stands in the book of Chronicles
Listing the sons who served in the land

[Chorus]
How the mighty have fallen
Your glory lies slain on your heights
The shield of the mighty is defiled
No longer anointed with oil

[Verse]
The Philistines closed in on the king
They struck down Jonathan and Abinadab
Malchi-shua fell with his father
On the slopes of Mount Gilboa
Many fell slain as the Israelites fled
Before the closing in of the enemy

[Chorus]
How the mighty have fallen
Your glory lies slain on your heights
The shield of the mighty is defiled
No longer anointed with oil

[Pre-Chorus]
They cut off his head and stripped his armor
Sent word to the temples of idols
They put his armor in the house of Ashtoreth
Fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan

[Verse]
But the people of Jabesh-gilead heard
All their fighting men set out by night
They took the bodies down from the wall
Brought them to Jabesh and burned them there
They took the bones and buried them
Under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh

[Chorus]
How the mighty have fallen
Your glory lies slain on your heights
The shield of the mighty is defiled
No longer anointed with oil

[Outro]
They fasted seven days for Saul
And for his sons who did not return
